description: Remove the deprecated API v1 endpoints and related code from the application. This is a breaking change that eliminates legacy API support that has been superseded by newer API versions for several years. Ensure all API v1 routes, serializers, tests, and configuration references are completely removed.
functional_requirements: Remove all API v1 endpoint definitions and routing from the views module
Delete API v1-specific serializers and any version-dependent logic in serialization
Update application settings to remove API v1 configuration and version references
Remove or update all tests that specifically test API v1 functionality
Ensure the application only exposes current supported API versions after changes
Update any documentation or API references to reflect the removal of v1 endpoints
